svg.aria-label: tokin, a gateway between agent harnesses and an inference engine. Each harness calls its own session URL with chat completions. Per turn tokin attaches the request to the session tree, renders only what is new while keeping the ids the model sampled (rollouts sampled as rollout, s stays so rather than re-encoding as roll, outs), generates on the engine from input tokens, and parses the output tokens into reasoning and tool calls for the harness. Each finished turn is appended to its rollout; a trainer collects the rollouts and updates the weights the engine serves.
